paper_title: Byzantine Lattice Agreement in Synchronous Message Passing Systems
statement: We have presented three algorithms for the Byzantine lattice agreement problem in synchronous systems. The first algorithm has early stopping property. The second algorithms take logarithmic rounds. The O(log f ) rounds upper bound matches the bound for the crash failure setting. For future work, the following questions are interesting: 1) Can we improve the upper bound or prove some lower bound on the round complexity? 2) Can we solve the BLA problem in asynchronous systems in logarithmic rounds? We have some partial results in [19], but the algorithm proposed can only tolerate f < n5 Byzantine failures.
